verdict.rationale: The evidence shows OAuth 2.0 lets an app act on a user's behalf, and Basecamp lets you invite AI agents and limit client visibility per project. None of it documents issuing API credentials with restricted scopes or least-privilege permissions for an agent. OAuth delegation and project-level visibility controls are adjacent features, not scoped credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
